description: Animate the post's current Claude design (same path as Animate with Claude in the editor) with a motion prompt. Returns a job; the MP4 is saved as a new video version on the post. Poll bamf.get_design. Never schedules or publishes. Costs credits.

instruction.description: The motion to add, e.g. a cursor moving to click the checkbox. Keep the design as is.

name: bamf.animate_design
